profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Jobot | Technical Leadership | AI-Accelerated Engineering | Architecture · Product · Developer Experience
profile.geoLocationName: Clifton Park, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Part human/part robot … Jobot is our own special way of blending the latest matching
technology with actual humans to provide the best job matches with incredible service.
Looking to hire or find a new job? Our experienced Jobot Pros work directly with you to
find the most relevant fit.

Staff Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing and building high-performance full-stack
applications across web, mobile, and desktop platforms using modern technologies. 

Skilled in leading end-to-end projects, defining development standards, and driving technical strategy. Experienced in hiring, mentoring, and fostering collaborative teams while delivering clean, scalable, and maintainable code.

Passionate about combining hands-on engineering expertise with strategic leadership to accelerate
innovation in forward-thinking engineering organizations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As a software developer for WhoSay, I concentrate on the user interface side of the product to develop web applications, pages and enhancements which ensure cross browser compatibility. I constantly think outside of the box to come up with new and creative ideas to serve up the data in easier and more visually appealing ways. I create easily readable, re-usable code using the MV* pattern that can be quickly picked up and used by anyone.

positions.title: Performance Engineer & QA Intern
positions.description:
As a Performance Engineer I developed a performance monitoring system for the Autotask application. This involved analyzing important features and creating/organizing performance monitoring scripts to measure the user experienced load time of most of the Autotask application.

As a QA Analyst I executed regression tests and performed ad-hoc testing. I identified bugs in the Autotask Application and created new tickets for them.
